simple.meaning: עָפָר (ʻâphâr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay , earth , mud.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 110 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 14 more, beginning at Genesis 2:7. Its contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָפָר (H6083).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עָפָר (ʻâphâr) / H6083 is traced through Genesis 2:7, Genesis 3:14, Genesis 3:19, Genesis 13:16 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay , earth , mud

definitions.full: H6083. aphar עָפָר noun masculine Lev 14:42 dry earth, dust ; — absolute ׳ע Gen 2:7 +, construct עֲפַר 13:16 +; suffix עֲפָרֵךְ Ezek 26:12 , עֲפָרוֺ Deut 9:21 , etc.; plural construct עַפְרֹת Job 28:6 ; Prov 8:26 ; — 1 literally: a. dry, loose earth , thrown (in malice) 2Sam 16:13 (|| אֲבָנִים ); ע ׳וַיַעֲלוּ עַלרֿאֹשׁ Josh 7:6 (J E; sign of grief), so Ezek 27:30 ; Lam 2:10 , and (with זָרַק ) Job 2:12 ; loose earth (on surface of ground) 1Kin 18:38 ; Amos 2:7 ; Micah 1:10 ; Isa 34:7 , 9 ; Lev 17:13 (H) Ezek 24:7 (in figurative), Num 5:17 ; Job 14:19 ; 38:38 ; 39:14 ; Gen 26:15 (R), made into siege works Hab 1:10 ; of sand-storm Deut 28:24 (+ אָבָק ); as serpent's food, token of punishment and humiliation, Gen 3:14 (J) Isa 65:25 (compare Micah 7:17 2e below); ע ׳זֹחֲלֵי Deut 32:24 (poem; compare 2e ). b. specifically as material of human body Gen 2:7 ; 3:19 (J), Eccl 3:20 , compare Job 4:19 ; 8:19 ; Psa 103:14 , to which it returns ( אֶלֿ שׁוּב ) Gen 3:19 ; Job 10:9 ; Psa 104:29 ; Eccl 3:20 ; so (with עַל ) Job 34:15 ; Eccl 12:7 . c. = surface of ground Exod 8:12 ; 8:13 (twice in verse); (P; ׳ע הָאָרַץ ), Job 19:25 ; Isa 25:12 ; 26:5 (both || אֶרֶץ ), surface of (whole) earth Job 41:25 , ע ׳מְחִלוֺת Isa 2:19 (for hiding), so ׳ע alone 2:10 , compare ע ׳חֹרֵי Job 30:6 ; = soil , 5:6 ; 14:8 . d. powder of anything pulverized Deut 9:21 (twice in verse) (compare דָּ֑ק || Exod 32:20 ), 2Kin 23:6 (twice in verse); 23:12 , 15 , so in simile 2Sam 22:43 = Psa 18:43 , hence = ashes 18:4 ; Num 19:17 . e. debris , of ruined city 1Kin 20:10 ; Ezek 26:4 , 12 ; Nehemiah 3:34; Neh 4:4 ; Psa 102:15 . The following are late: f. earth of the grave: ׳לֶע אֶשְׁכַּב Job 7:21 , so (with עַל ) 20:11 ; 21:26 , compare 17:16 ; ע ׳יוֺרְדֵי Psa 22:30 , ע ׳שֹׁכְנֵי Isa 26:19 , אַדְמַתעֿ ׳יְשֵׁנֵי Dan 12:2 ; עֲפַרמָֿוֶת Psa 22:16 ; ׳ע in figure 30:10 . g. mortar (i.e. dried mud) for plastering houses Lev 14:41-42 , 45 (P). h. (iron-) ore Job 28:2 ; זָהָב עַפְרֹת 28:6 gold-dust (but see סַמִּיר ). i. material of earth Isa 40:12 , compare תֵּבֵל עַפְרֹת ראֹשׁ Prov 8:26 the first of the earth particles of the world. 2 figurative: a. of abundance Gen 13:16 (twice in verse); 28:14 (all J) 2Chr 1:9 ; Job 27:16 ; Psa 78:27 (|| יַמִּים חוֺל ), compare יַעֲקֹב עֲפַר Num 23:10 (JE); with added idea of commonness, worthlessness Zeph 1:7 ; Zech 9:3 . b. of worthlessness (alone) Job 22:24 . c. simile of the scattered, dispersed 2Kin 13:7 ; ׳כֶּע Isa 41:2 (so van d. H. Ginsb; Baer ׳כֵּע ; on meaning see Du Che, reading תְּשִׂימֵם for יִתֵּן ). d. of self-abasement Gen 18:27 (+ אֵפַר ), וָאֵפֶר עַלעֿ ׳וְנִחַמְתִּי Job 42:6 , בֶּע ׳יִתֵּן מִּיהוּ Lam 3:29 . e. of humiliation (sitting or lying in dust) Isa 47:1 ; compare 29:4 (twice in verse), Job 16:15 ; 40:13 ; Psa 7:6 ; 44:26 ; 119:25 , simile Job 30:19 ; licking dust Psa 72:9 ; Isa 49:23 ; Micah 7:17 , compare Tel Amarna tikalu ipra (of enemies, see Wkl Altor. Forsch. iii. 291 ; also of serpent 1a above); of ׳י raising from the dust 1Sam 2:8 = Psa 113:7 , 1Kin 16:2 ; of lifting oneself Isa 52:2 .
